Dark
Promptery

A catalogue of the techniques that get text past a language model's safety training, documented the way you would actually chain them. Every entry states the mechanism (what it is), why it slips the filter, a canonical example, and the detection or defense that neutralises it. Organised by attack layer, from single codepoints to agent-level injection.

Start here — the one idea

A language model reads everything you hand it as one unbroken stream of text: your instructions, earlier turns, a page it fetched, a tool reply.

Nothing in that stream is stamped “trusted command” or “data only.” Prompt injection is writing ‘data’ the model carries out as a ‘command.’

The gap

That missing boundary is the whole subject. Every technique below is a different route across it.

Same gap, many routes

Swap a look-alike Unicode letter. Bury an order in a doc an agent will read. Edit the weights. Different clothes, same hole in the fence.
